gentleHints.compassion-britain: Trust includes respecting the wishes of the person who can lend the rune. Follow up with those close to her.
gentleHints.honesty-moonglow: A promise matters as much as the treasure. Remember what you agreed to do before leaving.
gentleHints.valor-jhelom: Consider whether someone much smaller than the Avatar could reach a place the party cannot.
gentleHints.justice-yew: Check a prisoner’s story with another witness before accepting it as truth.
gentleHints.sacrifice-minoc: A crafted instrument and a remembered song matter more here than strength.
gentleHints.honor-trinsic: A loan is not a gift. Remember the promise attached to what you borrow.
gentleHints.spirituality-skara-brae: Finding the rune and reaching its shrine are separate tasks. Ask about what the owner remembers.
gentleHints.humility-new-magincia: Listen to the villagers before answering the mayor. Humility is shown by behavior.
gentleHints.translate-the-gargish-tome: Look for a scholar who can examine writing the Avatar cannot read.
gentleHints.join-the-thieves-guild: Consider a quiet approach to the guild’s task; violence is not the only way to retrieve an object.
gentleHints.assemble-hawkinss-map: Several independent leads contribute to this search. Keep track of which fragments you have actually recovered.
gentleHints.plunder-the-pirate-cave: Follow the completed map carefully and remember any promise made in exchange for help.
gentleHints.reach-the-gargoyle-realm: Prepare for a deep descent and seek conversation before assuming every stranger is an enemy.
gentleHints.secure-diplomatic-access: A willing interpreter can help bridge the gap between cultures.
gentleHints.build-the-hot-air-balloon: Follow the plans and distinguish raw materials from the finished components they must become.
gentleHints.embrace-singularity: Listen to the teachings of each principle before trying to combine their lessons.
gentleHints.recover-the-vortex-cube: A peaceful exchange may open a door that force would leave closed.
gentleHints.forge-the-twin-lenses: Damaged craftsmanship and a new commission call for different skilled helpers.
gentleHints.prepare-the-codex-shrine: Check the charge and arrangement of your ritual tools separately before activating anything.
gentleHints.errands-of-the-lycaeum-library: A book’s value depends on who reads it. Match each work with an interested recipient.
gentleHints.chuckles-trail-of-clues: Treat the jester’s hunt as a chain: search the place named by your latest clue.
gentleHints.explore-the-swamp-cave: Prepare the whole party for the terrain before exploring deeper.
gentleHints.plunder-dungeon-deceit: Concealed hazards reward magical investigation and careful movement.
gentleHints.despise-and-the-heroes-hole: A connected optional cave offers exploration; it is not necessarily required for the main quest.
gentleHints.the-merchants-circuit: Compare what each settlement produces with what another settlement needs.

research.title: Gaining levels
research.text: In Ultima VI, a character who has earned enough experience gains the level by meditating at a shrine. The shrine’s virtue decides which attributes rise; Humility gives no attribute bonus.

research.title: Curing poison and sleep
research.text: In Ultima VI, drinking a red potion cures poison and other adverse status effects, while a blue potion awakens an ally who was put to sleep. The first-circle Dispel Magic spell (An Jux Ort; Garlic and Ginseng) also cures poison, removes paralysis, and awakens a sleeping party member.

premise.text: Gargoyles have seized Britannia's shrines because their dying world names the Avatar as its destroyer. Recover the stolen Codex, learn the truth behind the invasion, and end a war that cannot be solved by conquest alone.

situation.text: Gargoyles occupy the shrines while Britannia answers them with fear and steel. Behind the invasion lies the stolen Codex, a collapsing homeland, and a conflict that cannot be solved by conquest alone.

gypsy.text: The seven questions determine your starting attributes. The chart compares the potential bonuses attached to each virtue.

enlightenment.text: Experience alone does not grant levels. Meditate at cleansed shrines for permanent attribute growth.

party.text: You may recruit up to eight members to your party.
